heading: Writing
note: Occasional notes on the parts of a storefront nobody photographs.

posts.title: The size chart is a returns problem, not a design problem
posts.excerpt: Most size guides are written by whoever had the measurements, not by whoever answers the emails when the fit is wrong.

posts.title: Cart drawers hide the one number people want
posts.excerpt: Sliding the cart over the page keeps shoppers browsing, and keeps the total just far enough away to feel like a surprise at checkout.

posts.title: Nobody designs the empty search result
posts.excerpt: It is the screen a shopper sees at their most impatient, and usually the only one that was never opened in Figma.
